question: Is there an existing supported manual/operator path that covers the properties required to activate the original-conversation repair, without Root/Astra/ACP?
answer: A supported manual product path exists (`hermes update`), but for THIS installation it is blocked by the product's own admission contract before any update work starts. The blocker is not the absence of ACP.

a_owner_permission_to_update.evidence: owner message of 2026-11-07 authorises repair activation under direct TUI control

b_acting_operator_and_session_binding.detail: the product binds the operator entry to a pinned script+input pair (scripts/friday_native.py + FINAL-INPUT-SOURCE-CANDIDATE.json) and requires CLI argv to be exactly start-telegram --input <pinned> --deadline <n>; the current TUI session and `hermes update` do not satisfy that role

c_absence_of_conflicting_executions.detail: gateway pid 26334 running with active_agents=0; no tester processes; unfinished children have no processes. A second writer path (hermes update lock) is available and unused.

d_verification_of_installed_composition.detail: hermes update carries its own update receipt, update lock, plan phase, and post-update verification/restart; it verifies the checkout it publishes rather than the FRW source receipt

e_safe_publication_restart_recovery.detail: hermes update --plan is read-only; --no-gateway-restart defers fleet restart; gateway install/start/status/stop/restart are the admitted operator commands

observed_blockers_in_order.detail: plugins/friday_rework contained 19 __pycache__/*.pyc files while FRIDAY-INSTALL.json declares 48 source files; the owner check requires exact set equality and does not exempt bytecode. The .pyc files predate this session (mtime 2026-11-07T04:02). They were moved out to /home/jericho/.cache/FRW-PYCACHE-EVIDENCE-20261107 with their relative paths preserved; FRIDAY-INSTALL.json was not edited and no digest was rewritten.
observed_blockers_in_order.residual_risk: any later Python import of the plugin regenerates __pycache__ and re-breaks the same check unless the process runs with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 / python -B

observed_blockers_in_order.detail: friday_ordinary_gateway.invocation admits only an exact command list (gateway install/start/status/stop/uninstall/restart/run, dashboard --host .. --port .. --no-open) or exactly the pinned operator_entry role. `hermes update` and `hermes update --plan` are not admitted, so the CLI refuses before reaching the update code.

side_effects_this_turn.environment_sync: scripts/run-in-hermes-env ran pm sync (hash-verified against uv.lock) three times; no package versions were changed by hand
side_effects_this_turn.file_moves: only generated __pycache__ directories moved out of plugins/friday_rework

conclusion_for_owner: Activation does not need the old Root/Astra ACP controller, and does not need a new framework. It needs one narrow, explicit delta to the product's existing operator admission so that the owner-controlled manual update role is an admitted role with its own evidence, keeping every existing refusal for wrong composition, foreign owner, competing writer and unconfirmed service state.
next_step_proposal: prepare that narrow delta against friday_ordinary_gateway.invocation + FRIDAY-INSTALL ordinary_gateway.operator_entry, with the update path's own receipt as the evidence, then run it once at a safe boundary after the gateway confirms active_agents=0
